title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US - BBC
description: Roofs were ripped off buildings after Isaias barrelled into the US on Friday evening, before it weakened to a post-tropical cyclone.

title: House Republican, invoking Reagan, moves to block Trump's Russia oil deal - Axios

title: 9 dead in Pennsylvania shooting, Erie officials say - NBC News
description: A man killed seven family members and a family friend at a home in Erie, Pennsylvania, on Friday night before dying of an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound, officials said.

title: Live weather updates on Alabama-Georgia, Week 6 football as Isaias strikes - USA Today
description: With Hurricane Isaias moving inland, several college football games could be impacted. Here's the latest on Saturday's schedule, including the Alabama-Georgia matchup.

title: House candidate who reported rape on campaign trail on why she came forward: "What about all the women who are victims?" - CBS News
description: In the days since U.S. House candidate Bernadette Greene-Placentia publicly came forward alleging she was raped over the summer while repairing a campaign sign, she says women have been reaching out to her to share their own stories.
